profile.description: ThirstyFest is a volunteer-led craft beer fundraiser benefiting Water For People. Adult/21+ and beer-focused events are valid Adventure Zone prospects and must not be rejected solely for that reason. Current public material still centers on the 2025 event and does not show a confirmed 2026 festival date. If a 2026 edition is verified, evaluate Warrior's Playground and other competitive/adrenaline attractions first, along with space, hours, route economics and organizer interest.

notes.subject: Correction — adult event remains eligible
notes.body: Adventure Zone emailed ThirstyFest in 2023 and 2024 with no reply found. The prior non-fit conclusion based on craft beer/21+ format was incorrect. Adult events are eligible. Before outreach, first verify whether a 2026 event is actually scheduled; if confirmed, assess Warrior's Playground/adult competitive-attraction fit, available footprint, operating window and route economics.

followUps.label: Verify 2026 ThirstyFest and adult-event fit
followUps.reason: Adult/21+ is not a disqualifier. Confirm whether a 2026 event is scheduled, then assess Warrior's Playground/competitive attraction fit before history-aware outreach.
